title: CausalSSMContracts
description: Combined JSON Schema for exported artifact contracts and facade API models. Generated from Python Pydantic models.

ActionSpec.title: ActionSpec
ActionSpec.description: An action declares a machine operation and its interaction context.

AggregationFunction.description: An aggregation function summarizes observations within a measurement window.

ArtifactEnvelope.description:
An artifact envelope delivers a stored payload with its version, provenance, and file
list.
ArtifactEnvelope.title: ArtifactEnvelope

ArtifactFileSpec.title: ArtifactFileSpec
ArtifactFileSpec.description: An artifact file specification declares its JSON payloads, tables, and executable binaries.

ArtifactFreshness.title: ArtifactFreshness
ArtifactFreshness.description: An artifact's presence and freshness are derived from the selected journal revision.

ArtifactId.description: An artifact identity selects one node in the machine's artifact graph.

ArtifactRef.description: An artifact reference identifies the exact stored version that supports a model fact.
ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef

ArtifactVersionInfo.description:
Artifact version metadata records how a stored artifact was produced and which inputs it
used.

``derived_from`` pins the exact input versions the payload was computed
from. For root artifacts (user writes) it is empty. ``created_at`` is
stamped by the activity that produced the version — never inside workflow
code, where wall-clock time is non-deterministic.
ArtifactVersionInfo.title: ArtifactVersionInfo

ArtifactViewResponse.description: One available artifact projection returned by the model view endpoint.
ArtifactViewResponse.title: ArtifactViewResponse

ArtifactViews.description: Available artifact projections read from one committed model state.
ArtifactViews.title: ArtifactViews

AutoRunResponse.description: An auto-run acknowledgement identifies the active background episode driver.
AutoRunResponse.title: AutoRunResponse

BinaryExpression.description: A supported scalar operation composing two expressions.
BinaryExpression.title: BinaryExpression

BinaryOperator.description: A binary operator combines two scalar expression operands.

CallExpression.description: A supported mathematical function, including explicit discrete contrasts.
CallExpression.title: CallExpression

CapabilitiesResponse.description: This response tells clients whether the episode facade supports model-changing moves.
CapabilitiesResponse.title: CapabilitiesResponse

CausalEdgeSpec.description: A specification of a directed causal relationship between two constructs.

id.description: Persistent identity. Preserve when revising the same edge.

cause.description: Cause construct; shared endpoints have one identity.

effect.description: Effect construct; shared endpoints have one identity.

description.description: Theoretical justification for this causal link
description.title: Description

lagged.description: If True, effect at t is caused by cause at t-1 (one model_clock tick delay). If False (contemporaneous), effect at t is caused by cause at t.
lagged.title: Lagged

sources.description: Literature sources supporting this causal link
sources.title: Sources

CausalEdgeSpec.title: CausalEdgeSpec

CoefficientExpression.description: A scientifically typed coefficient operand, literal or parameter reference.

value.description: Finite literal or persistent parameter ID; null leaves the operand unassigned.
value.title: Value

construct_ids.description: Additional constructs participating in this coefficient use.
construct_ids.title: Construct Ids

CoefficientExpression.title: CoefficientExpression

CoefficientRole.description: A coefficient role identifies an expression operand’s scientific quantity and support.

ConstructId.description: A persistent construct identity survives changes to its display name.

ConstructRef.description:
A construct reference identifies a construct independently of its current name or
revision.
ConstructRef.title: ConstructRef

ConstructSpec.description: A specification of a theoretical entity in the scientific causal model.

id.description: Persistent identity. Preserve when revising or renaming.

distribution.description: Membership in a trajectory law in ModelSpec.distributions on ModelSpec.time_points.

role.description: 'endogenous' or 'exogenous' (no modeled causal parents; may still be uncertain)

ConstructSpec.title: ConstructSpec

ContextSpec.title: ContextSpec
ContextSpec.description: An interaction context declares the tools and machine actions available to an agent.

DensityPoint.description: A plotting coordinate evaluated from the native prior's log density.
DensityPoint.title: DensityPoint

Derivation.title: Derivation
Derivation.description: A derivation declares an artifact maintained atomically with its input versions.

DistributionId.description: A native law whose membership is defined by the model's scientific quantities.

DynamicsMechanismSpec.description: A dynamics mechanism declares one contribution to continuous-time drift.
DynamicsMechanismSpec.title: DynamicsMechanismSpec

EdgeId.description: A persistent edge identity identifies one authored causal relationship.

EdgeRef.description:
An edge reference identifies a causal relationship independently of edits to its
definition.
EdgeRef.title: EdgeRef

EffectSummary.description: An effect summary reports posterior location, uncertainty, and sign probability.

EffectTrajectoryPoint.description: An effect trajectory point records a causal delta at one rollout time.
EffectTrajectoryPoint.title: EffectTrajectoryPoint

EpisodeState.description:
Episode state identifies the artifact versions currently selected by the transition
journal.

``current`` maps artifact id → the version info that is *current* for the
episode. Absent key = the artifact does not exist (either never produced,
or produced-when-nonempty semantics withheld it).
EpisodeState.title: EpisodeState

EpisodeStatus.description: Episode status reports committed artifacts, their freshness, and available moves.
EpisodeStatus.title: EpisodeStatus

EventsResponse.description: An events response pages runtime telemetry without reconstructing model state.
EventsResponse.title: EventsResponse

Expression.description: A scalar expression composes supported arithmetic with scientific state and coefficient references.

ExpressionFunction.description: An expression function transforms scalar operands or constructs structured observation arguments.

FactSource.description: A fact source locates supporting content within an artifact version and records its freshness.
FactSource.title: FactSource

FitSummary.description: A fit read contains the inference log report and server-composed display findings.
FitSummary.title: FitSummary

HistogramBin.description: A histogram bin gives its interval, center, and number of posterior draws.
HistogramBin.title: HistogramBin

IdentificationReport.description: Positive and negative causal identification findings for the model's default query.

treatments.description: One tagged identification result per treatment, including its supporting evidence
treatments.title: Treatments

IdentificationReport.title: IdentificationReport

IdentifiedTreatmentStatus.description: Details on how a treatment effect is identified.

method.description: Nonparametric identification; linear-IV arguments do not certify ModelSpec.
method.title: Method

instruments.description: Instrument constructs appearing in the nonparametric identification argument

IndicatorAudit.description:
An indicator audit combines its empirical data profile with the results of validation
checks.

An empirical profile summarizes an indicator's observed values, coverage, and data-
quality signals.
IndicatorEmpiricalProfile.title: IndicatorEmpiricalProfile

IndicatorPolarity.description:
Indicator polarity states whether a measurement increases or decreases with its
construct.

An indicator reference identifies a measurement definition independently of its name or

IndicatorRef.title: IndicatorRef

IndicatorSpec.description: A specification of a construct's observed measurement and how to extract it.

id.description: Persistent identity. Preserve when revising or renaming.

how_to_measure.description: Instructions for workers on how to extract this from data
how_to_measure.title: How To Measure

construct_polarity.description: Whether higher indicator values move in the same direction as the construct (`positive`) or the opposite direction (`negative`).

aggregation.description: Aggregation function applied when bucketing raw extractions within the indicator support window. Measurement-structure support is currently limited to: first, last, sum, count, mean, std. Available parser operators: count, cv, entropy, first, instability, iqr, kurtosis, last, max, mean, median, min, n_unique, p10, p25, p75, p90, p99, range, skew, std, sum, trend, var

recording.description: Source recording semantics within the raw dataset's covered time span. samples: absent readings are unknown. events: a complete event record; empty sum/count windows are zero. changes: a complete change record; the last recorded value persists, with leading gaps unknown. events and changes require computed extraction.
recording.title: Recording

observation_window.description: Optional duration string describing the support window summarized by this indicator (for example '1mo' for a monthly average on a daily model clock). If omitted, the support window defaults to the global model_clock.
observation_window.title: Observation Window

ordinal_levels.description: Ordered list of level labels from lowest to highest for ordinal indicators (e.g., ['low', 'medium', 'high']). Required when measurement_dtype='ordinal' to ensure correct numeric encoding.
ordinal_levels.title: Ordinal Levels

categorical_levels.description: Exhaustive list of level labels for categorical indicators (e.g., ['home', 'work', 'other']). Required when measurement_dtype='categorical' to ensure correct numeric encoding.
categorical_levels.title: Categorical Levels

source_columns.description: Raw data column names referenced by how_to_measure. Used to project chunks to only relevant columns before extraction.
source_columns.title: Source Columns

computed_rule.description: Optional deterministic support-window expression for extraction_mode='computed'. Use this when a computed indicator needs formulas, thresholds, or multiple source columns instead of a direct single-column aggregation. The expression must return one scalar per support window.

extraction_mode.description: 'computed' (deterministic pipeline extraction) or 'semantic' (LLM extraction). Use 'computed' when the indicator can be derived deterministically either from a direct source-column aggregation or from a computed_rule support-window expression over the declared source_columns.
extraction_mode.title: Extraction Mode

InferenceMetadata.title: InferenceMetadata

inference_diagnostics.description: Engine-reported telemetry for this fit; keys and values are engine-defined.

LOODiagnostics.description:
Leave-one-out diagnostics assess predictive fit and the reliability of its cross-
validation estimate.

Exact emission factors on joint parameter/state draws support holding out
one measurement row. All other rows, including future rows, are available
for interpolation. PSIS reliability is assessed with Pareto-k diagnostics.
LOODiagnostics.title: LOODiagnostics

LikelihoodDiagnostics.title: LikelihoodDiagnostics

standardized.title: Standardized

reasoning.description: Why this conditional law was chosen for the indicator
reasoning.title: Reasoning

LikelihoodSpec.title: LikelihoodSpec

url.description: URL of the source if available

snippet.description: Relevant excerpt or paraphrase from the source

PPCOverlay.description:
A predictive overlay compares observed values with posterior predictive bands for one
indicator.

Provides the data for Gabry's ppc_dens_overlay / ppc_ribbon plots:
observed time series vs posterior predictive quantile bands.
Optionally includes individual y_rep draw lines for spaghetti plots.

A predictive test statistic compares an observed summary with its distribution under

ScenarioClamp.description:
A do-operator on one latent variable over a time window.

The window is ``[from_day, to_day)`` in days relative to the rollout start; outside
the window the variable evolves under its natural dynamics. ``set`` pins to an absolute
value, ``shift`` adds an amount to the variable's start-state value, ``ramp`` linearly
interpolates across the window, and ``trajectory`` tracks a list of values across it.

target.description: Persistent ID of the construct to clamp.

mode.description: How the clamped value is specified over the window.
mode.title: Mode

value.description: Required when mode='set'. Absolute latent-space value.
value.title: Value

amount.description: Required when mode='shift'. Additive delta from the start-state value.
amount.title: Amount

value_start.description: Required when mode='ramp'. Value at from_day.
value_start.title: Value Start

value_end.description: Required when mode='ramp'. Value at to_day.
value_end.title: Value End

values.description: Required when mode='trajectory'. Values sampled evenly across the window.
values.title: Values

from_day.description: Window onset in days from the rollout start.
from_day.title: From Day

to_day.description: Window end in days from the rollout start. Null runs through the horizon.
to_day.title: To Day

ScenarioClamp.title: ScenarioClamp

estimand.description: Report the final-horizon outcome effect or the full effect trajectory.
estimand.title: Estimand

horizon_days.description: Forward horizon in days from the rollout start.
horizon_days.title: Horizon Days

projection.description: Report latent outcome effects, manifest projections, or both.
projection.title: Projection

time_index.description: Abducted start only: observed fitted-state index to begin from. Defaults to the final retained fitted latent state.
time_index.title: Time Index

time.description: Abducted start only: ISO-8601 observed timestamp matching a retained fitted latent state. Use either time_index or time, not both.
